hooks.name: Protect Governance Files
hooks.description: Governance set = CODEOWNERS = governance-guard CI. Blocks .kiro/steering/ and .kiro/hooks/ (exit 2); asks for approval on the rest of .kiro/, .github/, root .ash/, bandit.yaml, .secrets.baseline; best-effort ask on shell writes to them. Kiro's local folders (.kiro/specs, settings, workflow-runs) and paths outside the repo are allowed.
